# Lines.FromText

```m
Lines.FromText(text as text, optional quoteStyle as any, optional includeLineSeparators as nullable logical) as list
```

Converts a text value to a list of text values split at lines breaks. If includeLineSeparators is true, then the line break characters are included in the text.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/lines-fromtext)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `text` | no |
| `quoteStyle` | `any` | yes |
| `includeLineSeparators` | `nullable logical` | yes |
